_about: Everything a member changes lives here. build.py reads it. Numbers are explained in SPEC.md.
_note: Example config, not real content. Stack and subtitle text must be your exact spoken words in order (build.py checks them against words-cut.json and stops if they don't match). Times, y positions and shot_cuts are example values from an 18.6 s demo take: Claude sets yours.
_cutout_note: Made from cut.mp4 by: npx --yes hyperframes@0.9.83 remove-background assets/cut.mp4 -o assets/cutout.webm --quality best
_shot_cuts_note: Hard cuts inside cut.mp4 on the cut clock (cut.py prints the joins).

bed._note: Optional, and not shipped: your own music file (one you hold the rights to). Missing = no bed; add music in the Edits window yourself (library music goes silent in Claude exports). enter_at = where in the track to start (on a downbeat).

stacks._note: lines = consecutive spoken words split into 2-3 lines; hero = the giant word; lilac = the ONE payoff word (or []). until = a later spoken word the stack holds until (leave it out to cut off on the next phrase).

_subtitle_lines_note: Empty = automatic line breaks. Better: Claude hand-sets them, every spoken word not in a stack, in order, as lines of 1-3 chunks, e.g. [["we can have", "a few ideas"], ["on the daily"]]. Start a chunk with > to pin it to the right slot.
